$$
S(n,k) = \log_k \left( \frac{2}{1} \cdot \frac{3}{2} \cdot \frac{4}{3} \cdots \frac{n}{n-1} \right)
$$

The product telescopes to:

$$
\frac{2}{1} \cdot \frac{3}{2} \cdot \frac{4}{3} \cdots \frac{n}{n-1} = n
$$

So,

$$
S(n,k) = \log_k n
$$
